verdict.rationale: Mangopay is a payments platform with a dashboard, so in-product AI insights from user data is a fair axis. The evidence does not show it. The fraud tooling consists of user-defined custom rules, not AI-generated insights. The llms.txt file, markdown docs and MCP server are developer and AI-agent access surfaces, not in-product insights or suggestions drawn from the user's data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
